# MCPJam validation — 2026-11-15

Target: http://fixture:8765/mcp. Project: project_fixture. CLI: @mcpj

am/cli 6.2.2.

## Results

- Authenticated doctor: ready; arithmetic-fixture 1.0.0, protocol 2025-11-25, one read-only add too
l.\n- Existing Arithmetic smoke suite: run_fixture_1 completed/passed, 1/1. Product explicitly labels execution SIMULATED, with no
hosted model or live billing. This does not establish hosted model performance.\n- Direct add(2,3): structuredContent.sum = 5; en
velope validation passed.\n- Zero, negative and fractional operands: passed. Missing operand and string operand: rejected with isE
rror=true.\n- Extra property: add({a:2,b:3,c:4}) returned sum=5, isError=false, despite published inputSchema.additionalProperties
=false. The server should enforce its advertised input schema or revise that schema to describe the accepted contract. This is a c
ontract mismatch; no remote implementation was changed.\n- Without the supplied token, initialization returned HTTP 401 invalid_to
ken. OAuth resource metadata returned 404. Static Bearer [REDACTED] with MCP_SERVER_TOKEN succeeds; no interactive OAuth is needed
for this validation. Original /workspace/mcp.json contains no authentication; replay.sh supplies the token from the environment.\
n- Full protocol conformance: 13 passed, 1 failed, 30 not applicable (14 applicable; score 92.8). The failure is wire-schema-valid
treating GET /mcp's HTTP 405 body {\\\"error\\\":\\\"Use POST\\\"} as a JSON-RPC message. GET-or-405 itself passed. The MCP trans
port specification explicitly permits HTTP 405 for this GET. The finding may be a checker false positive; the spec does not requir
e that response body to be JSON-RPC. Needs checker review, not a claim of full conformance.\n- Focused rerun of get-stream-or-405
and wire-schema-valid passed both. Full and focused results disagree; retain both reports. Do not use the focused pass to erase th
e full-run failure.\n- Hosted suite export refused UNSUPPORTED_SUITE_EXPORT because environment servers and model are absent and m
inimumIterations cannot be represented losslessly. Raw suite settings and cases are preserved instead; suite settings were not cha

nged to force export.

## Reproduce

Set MCP_SERVER_TOKEN, MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY in the environment, then run:

"'```sh
bash /workspace/validation/replay.sh
```

Requires Node/npm and Python 3. Pinned public npm CLI is used. The script w
rites new artifacts and launches one simulated hosted suite run. It exits nonzero while full conformance or edge expectations fail
. It stores no credential values. For local arithmetic checks only, run `python3 /workspace/validation/edge-cases.py`.\n\nKey arti
facts: doctor.json, add.json, edge-results.json, protocol.json, protocol-focused.json, get-response.json, probe-unauthenticated.js

on, run-first.json, iterations.json, suite-settings.json, cases.json, export.json.

r intentionally update the published schema, then rerun the checks. A MCPJam checker maintainer should review the full/focused wir
